{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Drop the six QA orders with revenue 999999.99
sales_clean = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99].copy()

# Drop refunded orders (status == 'refunded') — they are not real revenue
sales_clean = sales_clean[sales_clean['status'] == 'completed'].copy()

# Verify the final dataset
print("Number of rows after removing QA and refunded orders:", len(sales_clean))
print("Unique channels:", sales_clean['channel'].unique())

# Compute total revenue per channel
channel_revenue = sales_clean.groupby('channel', observed=True)['revenue_clean'].sum()
print("Channel revenue:", channel_revenue.to_dict())

# Identify the channel with the highest revenue
best_channel = channel_revenue.idxmax()
max_revenue = channel_revenue.max()

print("Best channel:", best_channel)
print("Max revenue:", max_revenue)"}
